name: Greenwich Park Playground
description: Maritime-themed inclusive playground for children up to 12, built with logs, rope and bark. It has a basket swing, a roundabout and sand and water play at ground level and in raised channels, so children with different abilities can play together. There's seating, picnic tables and a refreshment kiosk.

nearby.label: Children's toilets and an accessible toilet with baby change

sources.label: The Royal Parks: Greenwich Park Playground
